title.zh: 卷二百五十 列傳第一百三十八 孫承宗
title.raw: 卷二百五十 列傳第一百三十八 孫承宗 Volume 250 Biographies 138: Sun Chengzong

sentences.zh: 孫承宗子:鉁 等

translations.literal: Sons of Sun Chengzong: Qin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of Sun Chengzong: Qin, et al.

sentences.zh: 孫承宗

translations.literal: Sun Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chengzong

sentences.zh: 孫承宗，字稚繩，高陽人。

translations.literal: Sun Chengzong, styled Zhisheng, was a man of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chengzong, whose style name was Zhisheng, came from Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 貌奇偉，須髯戟張。

translations.literal: His appearance was strange and grand; his beard and mustache bristled like halberds.
translations.idiomatic: He had a striking, imposing bearing, with a beard and mustache that stood out like crossed halberds.

sentences.zh: 與人言，聲殷牆壁。

translations.literal: When he spoke with people, his voice resounded against the walls.
translations.idiomatic: When he spoke, his voice boomed so that the walls seemed to reverberate.

sentences.zh: 始為縣學生 ，授經邊郡。

translations.literal: At first he was a county school student and taught the classics in border commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a county school student and later taught the classics in the frontier districts.

sentences.zh: 往來飛狐、拒馬間，直走白登，又從紇干、清波故道南下。

translations.literal: He traveled back and forth between Feihu and Juma, went straight to Baideng, and again came south by the old routes of Heggan and Qingbo.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled between Feihu and Juma, went directly to Baideng, and also followed the old southern routes through Heggan and Qingbo.

sentences.zh: 喜從材官老兵究問險要厄塞，用是曉暢邊事。

translations.literal: He delighted in questioning talented officers and veteran soldiers about strategic passes and chokepoints, and thereby came to understand border affairs thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: He liked to question seasoned frontier officers about strategic terrain and passes, and in this way became thoroughly versed in border affairs.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三十二年，登進士第二人，授編修，進中允。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Wanli he placed second among the jinshi graduates, was appointed compiler, and advanced to junior mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 32 (1604) he ranked second on the jinshi examination, was appointed a Hanlin compiler, and later promoted to junior mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 「梃擊」變起，大學士吳道南以諮承宗。

translations.literal: When the "Staff Assault" incident arose, Grand Secretary Wu Daonan consulted Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: When the Staff Assault affair broke out, Grand Secretary Wu Daonan sought Chengzong's advice.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「事關東宮 ，不可不問；

translations.literal: He replied: "The matter concerns the Eastern Palace and cannot go uninvestigated;
translations.idiomatic: He answered: "Because it concerns the crown prince, it cannot go uninvestigated;

sentences.zh: 事連貴妃，不可深問。

translations.literal: the matter also involves the honored consort, and cannot be investigated too deeply.
translations.idiomatic: but because it also involves the imperial consort, it cannot be pursued too deeply.

sentences.zh: 龐保、劉成而下，不可不問也；

translations.literal: Below Pang Bao and Liu Cheng, one cannot fail to investigate;
translations.idiomatic: Those below Pang Bao and Liu Cheng must be questioned;

sentences.zh: 龐保、劉成而上，不可深問也。」

translations.literal: above Pang Bao and Liu Cheng, one cannot investigate too deeply.
translations.idiomatic: but those above Pang Bao and Liu Cheng must not be questioned too deeply.

sentences.zh: 道南如其言，具揭上之，事遂定。

translations.literal: Daonan followed his words, submitted a full memorial to the throne, and the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Daonan followed his advice, submitted a full report to the throne, and the matter was settled.

sentences.zh: 出典應天鄉試，發策著其語。

translations.literal: When he went out to preside over the Yingtian provincial examination, he set examination questions that quoted his words.
translations.idiomatic: When he served as chief examiner for the Yingtian provincial examination, his policy questions quoted his own remarks.

sentences.zh: 攖黨人忌，將以大計出諸外，學士劉一景保持，乃得免。

translations.literal: He provoked the enmity of faction members; they were about to remove him from the capital on a major pretext, but Academician Liu Yijing protected him, and he escaped punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He provoked the hostility of rival factions, who were about to banish him from the capital on a major pretext, but Academician Liu Yijing intervened on his behalf and he was spared.

sentences.zh: 歷諭德、洗馬。

translations.literal: He successively served as mentor and as study attendant of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as mentor and as study attendant to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 熹宗即位，以左庶子充日講官。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong ascended the throne, Chengzong served as left junior mentor and filled the post of daily lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xizong Emperor came to the throne, Chengzong was made left junior mentor and served as his daily lecturer.

sentences.zh: 帝每聽承宗講，輒曰「心開」，故眷注特殷。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor heard Chengzong lecture, he would say "my mind is opened," and therefore favored him with special warmth.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor heard Chengzong lecture, he would say, "My mind is opened," and therefore showed him exceptional favor.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年進少詹事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi he was promoted to junior commissioner of the heir apparent's household.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 1 (1621) he was promoted to junior commissioner of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 時沈、遼相繼失，舉朝洶洶。

translations.literal: At that time Shenyang and Liaoyang were lost in succession, and the whole court was in uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang and Liaoyang had just fallen in succession, and the entire court was in an uproar.

sentences.zh: 御史方震孺請罷兵部尚書崔景榮 ，以承宗代。

translations.literal: Censor Fang Zhenru asked that Minister of War Cui Jingrong be dismissed and Chengzong replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Fang Zhenru urged that Minister of War Cui Jingrong be removed and Chengzong put in his place.

sentences.zh: 廷臣亦皆以承宗知兵，遂推為兵部添設侍郎，主東事。

translations.literal: Court officials also all regarded Chengzong as knowing military affairs, and so he was promoted to an additionally appointed vice minister of war to take charge of eastern affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials likewise agreed that Chengzong understood military affairs, and he was therefore made an additional vice minister of war in charge of eastern frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 帝不欲承宗離講筵，疏再上不許。

translations.literal: The emperor did not wish Chengzong to leave the lecture seat; memorials submitted twice were not approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not want Chengzong to leave the lecture hall, and twice refused memorials urging his appointment elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 二年擢禮部右侍郎，協理詹事府。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to right vice minister of rites and assisted in managing the heir apparent's household.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to right vice minister of rites and helped administer the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大清兵逼廣寧，王化貞棄城走，熊廷弼與俱入關。

translations.literal: Before long the Great Qing army pressed on Guangning; Wang Huazhen abandoned the city and fled, and Xiong Tingbi entered the passes with him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Qing army threatened Guangning; Wang Huazhen abandoned the city and fled, and Xiong Tingbi retreated into the passes with him.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書張鶴鳴懼罪，出行邊。

translations.literal: Minister of War Zhang Heming, fearing blame, went out to inspect the border.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Zhang Heming, fearing punishment, went out to inspect the frontier.

sentences.zh: 帝亦急東事 ，遂拜承宗兵部尚書兼東閣大學士，入直辦事。

translations.literal: The emperor was also urgent about eastern affairs and therefore appointed Chengzong minister of war and concurrently Eastern Lodge grand secretary, entering duty to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was also deeply anxious about the eastern frontier, and so appointed Chengzong minister of war and concurrently Eastern Lodge grand secretary, with duty at court.

sentences.zh: 越數日，命以閣臣掌部務。

translations.literal: After several days he was ordered, as a grand secretary, to take charge of ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A few days later he was ordered, as a grand secretary, to take charge of the ministry's affairs.

sentences.zh: 承宗上疏曰：「邇年兵多不練，餉多不核。

translations.literal: Chengzong submitted a memorial saying: "In recent years troops are mostly untrained and rations mostly unaccounted for.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong submitted a memorial saying: "In recent years the troops are largely untrained and the rations largely unaudited.

sentences.zh: 以將用兵，而以文官招練；

translations.literal: Generals are to employ troops, yet civil officials recruit and drill them;
translations.idiomatic: Generals are supposed to command troops, yet civil officials recruit and drill them;

sentences.zh: 以將臨陣，而以文官指發；

translations.literal: generals are to face battle, yet civil officials direct deployments;
translations.idiomatic: generals are supposed to face battle, yet civil officials direct deployments;

sentences.zh: 以武略備邊，而日增置文官於幕；

translations.literal: military strategy is to defend the border, yet civil officials are daily added to staffs;
translations.idiomatic: military strategy is meant to defend the frontier, yet more civil officials are added to staffs every day;

sentences.zh: 以邊任經、撫，而日問戰守於朝；

translations.literal: border duties are entrusted to commissioners and governors, yet war and defense are daily questioned at court;
translations.idiomatic: frontier commissioners and governors are entrusted with the border, yet war and defense are debated daily at court—

sentences.zh: 此極弊也。

translations.literal: these are extreme abuses.
translations.idiomatic: these are the worst abuses imaginable.

sentences.zh: 今天下當重將權，擇一沉雄有氣略者，授之節鉞，得自辟置偏裨以下，勿使文吏用小見沾沾陵其上。

translations.literal: Now under Heaven one should emphasize general authority, choose a man deep and bold with strategic spirit, grant him the tally and axe, let him appoint officers from deputy commanders downward on his own, and not let civil clerks with petty views presumptuously override him.
translations.idiomatic: The empire should now restore real authority to generals: choose a man of depth, boldness, and strategic vision, grant him full command, let him appoint his own officers down to the rank of deputy commander, and do not let petty civil officials ride over him with small-minded objections.

sentences.zh: 邊疆小勝小敗，皆不足問，要使守關無闌入，而徐為恢復計。」

translations.literal: Small victories and small defeats on the frontier are not worth inquiry; what is needed is to keep the passes so that none break through, and slowly make plans for recovery."
translations.idiomatic: Minor frontier victories and defeats are not worth debating; what matters is to hold the passes so that no enemy breaks through, and then plan recovery step by step."

sentences.zh: 因列上撫西部、恤遼民、簡京軍、增永平大帥、修薊鎮亭障、開京東屯田數策，帝褒納焉。

translations.literal: He then listed policies for pacifying the western tribes, relieving Liaodong people, streamlining capital troops, adding a supreme commander at Yongping, repairing Ji garrison watchtowers and barriers, and opening military colonies east of the capital; the emperor praised and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted several policies—pacifying the western tribes, relieving the people of Liaodong, streamlining capital troops, adding a supreme commander at Yongping, repairing Ji garrison defenses, and opening military colonies east of the capital—and the emperor praised and accepted them.

sentences.zh: 時邊警屢告，閣部大臣幸旦暮無事，而言路日益紛呶。

translations.literal: At that time border alarms were repeatedly reported; grand secretaries and ministers were fortunate if nothing happened from morning to night, while the remonstrance offices grew daily more clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Border alarms were coming in repeatedly; grand secretaries and ministers counted themselves lucky if each day passed without crisis, while the censorial and remonstrance offices grew ever more clamorous.

sentences.zh: 承宗乃請下廷弼於理，與化貞並讞，用正朝士黨護。

translations.literal: Chengzong then asked that Tingbi be handed over to the law and jointly tried with Huazhen, to correct court gentlemen's factional protection.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong then asked that Xiong Tingbi be handed over for trial and jointly judged with Wang Huazhen, so as to curb the court factions that had been shielding them.

sentences.zh: 又請逮給事中明時舉、御史李達，以懲四川之招兵致寇者。

translations.literal: He also asked that supervising secretaries Ming Shiju and censor Li Da be arrested, to punish those in Sichuan who recruited troops and thereby brought on bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that supervising secretary Ming Shiju and censor Li Da be arrested, to punish those in Sichuan whose reckless recruitment of troops had invited rebellion.

sentences.zh: 又請詰責遼東巡按方震孺、登萊監軍梁之垣、薊州兵備邵可立，以警在位之骫骳者。

translations.literal: He also asked that Liaodong touring censor Fang Zhenru, Deng-Lai army supervisor Liang Zhiyuan, and Jizhou military intendant Shao Keli be called to account, to warn those in office who were crooked and timid.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that Liaodong touring censor Fang Zhenru, Deng-Lai army supervisor Liang Zhiyuan, and Jizhou military intendant Shao Keli be called to account, as a warning to timid and evasive officials still in office.

sentences.zh: 諸人以次獲譴，朝右聳然，而側目怨咨者亦眾矣。

translations.literal: These men were punished in turn one after another; the court was stirred, yet those who looked askance in resentment and complaint were also many.
translations.idiomatic: These men were punished one after another; the court was shaken, but many also looked on with resentment and complaint.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書王在晉代廷弼經略遼東，與總督王象乾深相倚結。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Zaijin replaced Tingbi as Liaodong commissioner, and was deeply allied with Governor-General Wang Xiangqian.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Wang Zaijin replaced Xiong Tingbi as Liaodong commissioner and was closely allied with Governor-General Wang Xiangqian.

sentences.zh: 象乾在薊門久，習知西部種類情性，西部亦愛戴之，然實無他才 ，惟啖以財物相羈縻，冀得以老解職而已。

translations.literal: Xiangqian had long been at the Ji gate, was practiced in knowing the dispositions of western tribes, and the western tribes also loved and supported him; yet in truth he had no other talent and only fed them goods to restrain them, hoping to retire on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian had long served at the Ji frontier, knew the western tribes well, and was popular among them; but he had no real ability and relied only on gifts to keep them in check, hoping to retire on grounds of age.

sentences.zh: 在晉謀用西部襲廣寧，象乾惎之曰：「得廣寧，不能守也，獲罪滋大。

translations.literal: Zaijin planned to use the western tribes to strike Guangning; Xiangqian dissuaded him, saying: "If we take Guangning and cannot hold it, the offense will be even greater.
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin planned to use the western tribes to retake Guangning, but Xiangqian dissuaded him, saying, "If we take Guangning and cannot hold it, our guilt will be even greater.

sentences.zh: 不如重關設險，衛山海以衛京師。」

translations.literal: It is better to build layered passes and set up defenses, guarding Shanhai to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Better to build layered defenses and guard Shanhai Pass in order to protect the capital.

sentences.zh: 在晉乃請於山海關外八里鋪築重關，用四萬人守之。

translations.literal: Zaijin then asked to build a layered pass at Balipu outside Shanhai Pass and garrison it with forty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin then proposed building a second line of fortifications at Balipu, eight li outside Shanhai Pass, and garrisoning it with forty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 其僚佐袁崇煥、沈棨、孫元化等力爭不能得，奏記於首輔葉向高。

translations.literal: His subordinates Yuan Chonghuan, Shen Qi, Sun Yuanhua, and others argued strenuously but could not prevail, and submitted a report to Chief Grand Secretary Ye Xianggao.
translations.idiomatic: His subordinates Yuan Chonghuan, Shen Qi, Sun Yuanhua, and others argued strenuously in vain and submitted a report to Chief Grand Secretary Ye Xianggao.

sentences.zh: 向高曰：「是未可臆度也。」

translations.literal: Xianggao said: "This cannot be judged in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Xianggao said, "That cannot be decided in advance.

sentences.zh: 承宗請身往決之。

translations.literal: Chengzong asked to go in person to decide it.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong asked to go in person to settle the question.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，加太子太保，賜蟒玉、銀幣。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, added the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and bestowed python robes, jade, and silver coins.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted, promoted him to junior guardian of the heir apparent, and bestowed python robes, jade, and silver.

sentences.zh: 抵關，詰在晉曰：「新城成，即移舊城四萬人以守乎？」

translations.literal: On reaching the pass he questioned Zaijin: "When the new fort is completed, will the forty thousand men of the old fort be moved to garrison it?
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the pass he questioned Zaijin: "When the new fort is finished, will you move the old fort's forty thousand men to garrison it?

sentences.zh: 在晉曰：「否，當更設兵。」

translations.literal: Zaijin said: "No; troops must be newly assigned."
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin said, "No—we must assign new troops."

sentences.zh: 曰：「如此，則八里內守兵八萬矣。

translations.literal: Chengzong said: "If so, then within eight li there will be eighty thousand garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong said, "In that case there will be eighty thousand garrison troops within eight li.

sentences.zh: 一片石西北不當設兵乎？

translations.literal: Should troops not also be posted northwest of Yipianshi?
translations.idiomatic: Should we not also post troops northwest of Yipianshi?

sentences.zh: 且築關在八里內，新城背即舊城趾，舊城之品坑地雷為敵人設，抑為新兵設乎？

translations.literal: Moreover, if the pass is built within eight li, the back of the new fort will be at the base of the old fort—were the old fort's stockades, pits, and land mines set for the enemy, or for the new troops?
translations.idiomatic: Besides, if the new fort is built eight li inside the pass, its rear will abut the old fort—were the old fort's trenches, pits, and land mines laid for the enemy, or for your new troops?

sentences.zh: 新城可守，安用舊城？

translations.literal: If the new fort can be held, what use is the old fort?
translations.idiomatic: If the new fort can be held, why keep the old one?

sentences.zh: 如不可守，則四萬新兵倒戈舊城下，將開關延入乎，抑閉關以委敵乎？」

translations.literal: If it cannot be held, then when the forty thousand new troops turn their weapons beneath the old fort, will they open the pass to let the enemy in, or close it and hand it over to the enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: If it cannot be held, when your forty thousand new troops turn on the old fort below them, will they open the gate to let the enemy in, or close it and surrender the pass?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「關外有三道關可入也。」

translations.literal: Zaijin said: "Outside the pass there are three passes by which one can enter."
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin said, "There are three passes outside by which one can still enter."

sentences.zh: 曰：「若此，則敵至而兵逃如故也，安用重關？」

translations.literal: Chengzong said: "If so, when the enemy comes the troops will flee as before—what use is a layered pass?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong said, "Then when the enemy comes the troops will flee just as before—what use is a second line of fortifications?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「將建三寨於山，以待潰卒。」

translations.literal: Zaijin said: "Three stockades will be built on the mountains to await routed soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin said, "We will build three stockades on the hills to receive routed troops."

sentences.zh: 曰：「兵未潰而築寨以待之，是教之潰也。

translations.literal: Chengzong said: "If troops have not yet routed but stockades are built to await them, this teaches them to rout.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong said, "If you build stockades before the troops have routed, you are teaching them to rout.

sentences.zh: 且潰兵可入，敵亦可尾之入。

translations.literal: Moreover, routed troops may enter, but the enemy can also follow them in.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, routed troops may enter—but so can the enemy following close behind them.

sentences.zh: 今不為恢復計，畫關而守，將盡撤籓籬，日哄堂奧，畿東其有寧宇乎？」

translations.literal: Now, without making plans for recovery, to draw a line at the pass and defend it will pull up all outer defenses; day by day the enemy will press into the inner chambers—will the eastern capital region have any peace?"
translations.idiomatic: If we make no plan for recovery but merely draw a line at the pass and defend it, we will pull up every outer defense; day by day the enemy will press toward the heartland—will the eastern capital region ever know peace?"

sentences.zh: 在晉無以難。

translations.literal: Zaijin had no way to refute this.
translations.idiomatic: Zaijin had no answer.

sentences.zh: 承宗乃議守關外。

translations.literal: Chengzong then discussed defending outside the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong then proposed holding territory outside the pass.

sentences.zh: 監軍閻鳴泰主覺華島，袁崇煥主寧遠衛，在晉持不可，主守中前所。

translations.literal: Army supervisor Yan Mingtai was to take charge of Juehua Island, Yuan Chonghuan of Ningyuan Guard; Zaijin held that this would not do and advocated holding Zhongqiansuo.
translations.idiomatic: Army supervisor Yan Mingtai was assigned Juehua Island and Yuan Chonghuan Ningyuan Guard; Zaijin objected and insisted on holding only Zhongqiansuo.

sentences.zh: 舊監司邢慎言、張應吾逃在關，皆附和之。

translations.literal: Former supervisors Xing Shenyan and Zhang Yingwu, who had fled to the pass, all echoed him.
translations.idiomatic: Former supervisors Xing Shenyan and Zhang Yingwu, who had fled to the pass, all sided with him.

sentences.zh: 初，化貞等既逃，自寧遠以西五城七十二堡悉為哈喇慎諸部所據，聲言助守邊。

translations.literal: At first, after Huazhen and others had fled, from Ningyuan westward five cities and seventy-two forts were all occupied by the Kharchin tribes, who claimed to be helping guard the border.
translations.idiomatic: After Huazhen and the others fled, the five cities and seventy-two forts west of Ningyuan were all seized by the Kharchin tribes, who claimed they were helping guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 前哨游擊左輔名駐中前，實不出八里鋪。

translations.literal: The forward ranger Zuo Fu was nominally posted at Zhongqian, but in fact did not go beyond Balipu.
translations.idiomatic: Forward ranger Zuo Fu was nominally stationed at Zhongqian but in fact never ventured beyond Balipu.

sentences.zh: 承宗知諸部不足信 ，而寧遠、覺華之可守，已決計將自在晉發之，推心告語凡七晝夜，終不應。

translations.literal: Chengzong knew the tribes were not to be trusted, and that Ningyuan and Juehua could be held; he had already resolved to set out from Zaijin, and spoke to him frankly for seven days and nights, but in the end received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong knew the tribes could not be trusted and that Ningyuan and Juehua could be held; he had already decided to act despite Zaijin and spoke to him frankly for seven days and nights, but Zaijin would not agree.

sentences.zh: 還朝，言：「敵未抵鎮武而我自燒寧、前，此前日經、撫罪也；

translations.literal: On returning to court he said: "The enemy had not yet reached Zhenwu and we ourselves burned Ning and Qian—this was the fault of the former commissioners and governors;
translations.idiomatic: On returning to court he said: "The enemy had not yet reached Zhenwu when we ourselves abandoned Ningyuan and the forward posts—that was the fault of the former commissioners and governors;

sentences.zh: 我棄寧、前，敵終不至，而我不敢出關一步，此今日將吏罪也。

translations.literal: we abandoned Ning and Qian, yet the enemy in the end did not come, while we dare not step one pace outside the pass—this is the fault of today's generals and officials.
translations.idiomatic: we abandoned Ningyuan and the forward posts, yet the enemy still has not come, while we dare not step one pace outside the pass—that is the fault of today's generals and officials.

sentences.zh: 將吏匿關內，無能轉其畏敵之心以畏法，化其謀利之智以謀敵，此臣與經臣罪也。

translations.literal: Generals and officials hide inside the pass, unable to turn their fear of the enemy into fear of law, or transform their scheming for profit into scheming against the enemy—this is the fault of myself and the minister in charge.
translations.idiomatic: Generals and officials hide inside the pass, unable to turn their fear of the enemy into fear of the law or their scheming for profit into scheming against the enemy—that is my fault and the fault of the minister in charge.

sentences.zh: 與其以百萬金錢浪擲於無用之版築，曷若築寧遠要害？

translations.literal: Rather than squander a million in cash on useless fortification works, why not build the strategic point at Ningyuan?
translations.idiomatic: Rather than squander a million taels on useless fortifications, why not build up the strategic strongpoint at Ningyuan?

sentences.zh: 以守八里鋪之四萬人當寧遠沖，與覺華相犄角。

translations.literal: Use the forty thousand men guarding Balipu to confront the thrust toward Ningyuan, and set them in pincer support with Juehua.
translations.idiomatic: Deploy the forty thousand men now guarding Balipu to hold the approach to Ningyuan, with Juehua Island as a supporting pincer.

sentences.zh: 敵窺城，令島上卒旁出三岔，斷浮橋，繞其後而橫擊之。

translations.literal: When the enemy scouts the city, order the island troops to sally out by Sancha on the flank, cut the pontoon bridge, circle behind them, and strike across.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy probes the city, troops on the island can sally out through Sancha, cut the pontoon bridge, circle behind them, and strike from the rear.

sentences.zh: 即無事，亦且收二百里疆土。

translations.literal: Even if nothing happens, we will still recover two hundred li of territory.
translations.idiomatic: Even if no battle is fought, we will still recover two hundred li of territory.

sentences.zh: 總之，敵人之帳幕必不可近關門，杏山之難民必不可置膜外。

translations.literal: In sum, the enemy's tents must not be allowed near the pass gate, and the refugees of Xingshan must not be left outside our screen.
translations.idiomatic: In short, the enemy's camps must not be allowed to approach the pass, and the refugees of Xingshan must not be abandoned beyond our defenses.

sentences.zh: 不盡破庸人之論，遼事不可為也。」

translations.literal: Unless the arguments of mediocre men are thoroughly overturned, Liaodong affairs cannot be accomplished."
translations.idiomatic: Unless we thoroughly overturn the arguments of mediocre men, nothing can be done for Liaodong."

sentences.zh: 其他制置軍事又十余疏。

translations.literal: He also submitted more than ten other memorials on military arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted more than ten further memorials on military arrangements.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted them.

sentences.zh: 無何，御講筵，承宗面奏在晉不足任，乃改南京兵部尚書，並斥逃臣慎言等，而八里築城之議遂熄。

translations.literal: Before long, at the imperial lecture hall Chengzong memorialized in person that Zaijin was unfit for office; Zaijin was then transferred to minister of war at Nanjing, fugitive officials such as Shenyan were also dismissed, and the proposal to build a fort at Bali was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, at the imperial lecture hall Chengzong reported in person that Zaijin was unfit for office; Zaijin was transferred to minister of war at Nanjing, fugitive officials such as Shenyan were dismissed, and the Balipu fortification plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 在晉既去，承宗自請督師。

translations.literal: After Zaijin had left, Chengzong asked on his own to supervise the army.
translations.idiomatic: After Zaijin left, Chengzong volunteered to take command in the field.

sentences.zh: 詔給關防敕書，以原官督山海關及薊、遼、天津、登、萊諸處軍務，便宜行事，不從中制 ，而以鳴泰為遼東巡撫。

translations.literal: An edict granted him the pass seal and commission document; with his original rank he was to supervise military affairs at Shanhai Pass and in Ji, Liaodong, Tianjin, Deng, and Lai, acting as expedient without awaiting central orders, while Mingtai was made Liaodong governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the pass seal and an imperial commission to supervise military affairs at Shanhai Pass and in Ji, Liaodong, Tianjin, Deng, and Lai, with authority to act on his own discretion without awaiting orders from the capital; Yan Mingtai was made Liaodong governor.

sentences.zh: 承宗乃辟職方主事鹿善繼、王則古為贊畫，請帑金八十萬以行。

translations.literal: Chengzong then recruited Bureau of War section chiefs Lu Shanji and Wang Zegu as staff planners and asked for eight hundred thousand in treasury gold for the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong then appointed Bureau of War section chiefs Lu Shanji and Wang Zegu as staff planners and requested eight hundred thousand taels from the treasury for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 帝特御門臨遣，賜尚方劍、坐蟒，閣臣送之崇文門外。

translations.literal: The emperor specially came to the gate in person to send him off, bestowed the imperial sword and seated-python robe, and grand secretaries escorted him outside Chongwen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor came in person to the palace gate to send him off, bestowed the imperial sword and python robe, and grand secretaries escorted him as far as outside Chongwen Gate.

sentences.zh: 既至關，令總兵江應詔定軍制，僉事崇煥建營舍，廢將李秉誠練火器，贊畫善繼、則古治軍儲，沈棨、杜應芳繕甲仗，司務孫元化築砲臺，中書舍人宋獻、羽林經歷程侖主市馬，廣寧道僉事萬有孚主採木，而令游擊祖大壽佐金冠於覺華，副將陳諫助趙率教於前屯，游擊魯之甲拯難民，副將李承先練騎卒，參將楊應乾募遼人為軍。

translations.literal: Once he reached the pass, he ordered regional commander Jiang Ying'e to fix military regulations, commissioner Yuan Chonghuan to build barracks, dismissed general Li Bingcheng to drill firearms, staff planners Shanji and Zegu to manage military stores, Shen Qi and Du Yingfang to repair armor and weapons, clerk Sun Yuanhua to build gun platforms, secretariat attendant Song Xian and imperial guard clerk Cheng Lun to manage horse markets, Guangning circuit commissioner Wan Youfu to procure timber, and assigned ranger Zu Dashou to assist Jin Guan at Juehua, vice commander Chen Jian to assist Zhao Shuaijiao at Qiantun, ranger Lu Zhijia to rescue refugees, vice commander Li Chengxian to drill cavalry, and colonel Yang Yingqian to recruit Liaodong men as troops.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the pass he put regional commander Jiang Ying'e in charge of military regulations, commissioner Yuan Chonghuan in charge of building barracks, dismissed general Li Bingcheng in charge of drilling firearms, staff planners Shanji and Zegu in charge of supplies, Shen Qi and Du Yingfang in charge of repairing armor and weapons, clerk Sun Yuanhua in charge of building gun platforms, secretariat attendant Song Xian and imperial guard clerk Cheng Lun in charge of purchasing horses, Guangning circuit commissioner Wan Youfu in charge of procuring timber, ranger Zu Dashou to assist Jin Guan on Juehua Island, vice commander Chen Jian to assist Zhao Shuaijiao at Qiantun, ranger Lu Zhijia to rescue refugees, vice commander Li Chengxian to drill cavalry, and colonel Yang Yingqian to recruit Liaodong men into the army.

sentences.zh: 是時，關上兵名七萬，顧無紀律，冒餉多。

translations.literal: At that time the troops at the pass numbered seventy thousand in name, but lacked discipline and had many false claims on rations.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the pass nominally had seventy thousand troops, but they lacked discipline and rations were widely padded.

sentences.zh: 承宗大閱，汰逃將數百人 ，遣還河南、真定疲兵萬余，以之甲所救難民七千發前屯為兵。

translations.literal: Chengzong held a great review, eliminated several hundred fugitive generals, sent back more than ten thousand exhausted troops from Henan and Zhending, and sent seven thousand refugees rescued by Lu Zhijia to Qiantun as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong held a grand review, eliminated several hundred deserter officers, sent back more than ten thousand exhausted troops from Henan and Zhending, and deployed seven thousand refugees rescued by Lu Zhijia to Qiantun as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 應乾所募遼卒出戍寧遠，咨朝鮮使助聲援。

translations.literal: The Liaodong soldiers recruited by Yingqian went out to garrison Ningyuan, and Korea was consulted to lend supporting clamor.
translations.idiomatic: The Liaodong troops Yingqian had recruited were sent to garrison Ningyuan, and Korea was asked to lend supporting pressure.

sentences.zh: 犒毛文龍於東江，令復四衛。

translations.literal: He rewarded Mao Wenlong on the Eastern River and ordered him to recover the four guards.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded Mao Wenlong on the Eastern River and ordered him to recover the four guards.

sentences.zh: 檄登帥沈有容進據廣鹿島。

translations.literal: He issued an order to Deng commander Shen Yourong to advance and hold Guanglu Island.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Deng commander Shen Yourong to advance and occupy Guanglu Island.

sentences.zh: 欲以春防躬詣登、萊商進取，而中朝意方急遼，弗許也。

translations.literal: He wished during the spring defense to go in person to Deng and Lai to discuss advance, but the central court was then urgent about Liaodong and did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He wished to go in person to Deng and Lai during the spring defense to plan an offensive, but the court was focused on Liaodong and would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 應詔被劾，承宗請用馬世龍代之，以尤世祿、王世欽為南北帥，聽世龍節制，且為世龍請尚方劍。

translations.literal: Ying'e was impeached; Chengzong asked that Ma Shilong replace him, made You Shilu and Wang Shiqin northern and southern commanders subject to Shilong's control, and also asked an imperial sword for Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying'e was impeached, Chengzong asked that Ma Shilong replace him, appointed You Shilu and Wang Shiqin as northern and southern commanders under Shilong's authority, and also requested an imperial sword for Shilong.

sentences.zh: 帝皆可之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 世龍既受事，承宗為築壇，拜行授鉞禮。

translations.literal: After Shilong had accepted office, Chengzong built an altar and performed the ceremony of bowing and conferring the axe.
translations.idiomatic: After Shilong took command, Chengzong built an altar and performed the ceremony of investing him with command.

sentences.zh: 率教已守前屯，盡驅哈喇慎諸部，撫場猶在八里鋪。

translations.literal: Shuaijiao was already guarding Qiantun, had driven out all the Kharchin tribes, yet the market for pacifying trade still remained at Balipu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shuaijiao was already holding Qiantun and had driven out all the Kharchin tribes, but the pacification market still remained at Balipu.

sentences.zh: 象乾議開水關，撫之關內，承宗不可，乃定於高臺堡。

translations.literal: Xiangqian proposed opening the Water Pass and pacifying the tribes inside the pass; Chengzong would not agree, and it was finally fixed at Gaotaibao.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian proposed opening the Water Pass and keeping the tribes inside the pass; Chengzong objected, and the market was finally established at Gaotaibao.

sentences.zh: 時大清兵委廣寧去，遼遺民入居之。

translations.literal: At that time the Great Qing army had abandoned Guangning and left; Liaodong remnant people moved in to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing army had just abandoned Guangning, and Liaodong refugees moved back in.

sentences.zh: 插漢部以告有孚，有孚謀挾西部乘間殲之，冒恢復功。

translations.literal: The Chahar tribe reported this to Youfu; Youfu planned to use the western tribes to destroy them at an opportune moment and claim merit for recovery.
translations.idiomatic: The Chahar reported this to Wan Youfu, who planned to use the western tribes to wipe them out and claim credit for recovering the territory.

sentences.zh: 承宗下檄曰：「西部殺我人者，致罰如盟言。」

translations.literal: Chengzong issued a dispatch saying: "Whoever among the western tribes kills our people shall be punished according to the covenant.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong issued an order: "Any western tribe that kills our people shall be punished as the treaty requires.

sentences.zh: 是役也 ，全活千余人。

translations.literal: In this operation more than a thousand people were entirely saved alive.
translations.idiomatic: In this affair more than a thousand lives were saved.

sentences.zh: 帝好察邊情，時令東廠遣人詣關門，具事狀奏報，名曰「較事」。

translations.literal: The emperor liked to scrutinize border conditions and at times ordered the Eastern Depot to send men to the pass gate to report full accounts of affairs, called "comparing matters."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor liked to keep close watch on frontier affairs and often sent Eastern Depot agents to the pass to report detailed accounts, called "verification reports."

sentences.zh: 及魏忠賢竊政，遣其黨劉朝、胡良輔、紀用等四十五人齎內庫神砲、甲仗、弓矢之屬數萬至關門，為軍中用，又以白金十萬，蟒、麒麟、獅子、虎、豹諸幣頒賚將士，而賜承宗蟒服、白金慰勞之，實覘軍也。

translations.literal: When Wei Zhongxian usurped power he sent his partisans Liu Chao, Hu Liangfu, Ji Yong, and forty-five others bearing tens of thousands of divine cannon, armor, bows, and arrows from the inner treasury to the pass for army use; he also distributed one hundred thousand taels of white silver and banners with python, qilin, lion, tiger, and leopard designs to reward officers and soldiers, and bestowed python robes and white silver on Chengzong to comfort him—in truth to spy on the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Zhongxian seized power he sent his followers Liu Chao, Hu Liangfu, Ji Yong, and forty-five others with tens of thousands of imperial cannon, armor, bows, and arrows from the inner treasury for use at the pass; he also distributed one hundred thousand taels of silver and ceremonial banners to reward the troops, and gave Chengzong python robes and silver as a gesture of comfort—in reality to spy on the army.

sentences.zh: 承宗方出關巡寧遠，中路聞之，立疏言：「中使觀兵，自古有戒。」

translations.literal: Chengzong was just then going out of the pass to inspect Ningyuan; midway he heard of it and immediately submitted a memorial saying: "Eunuch envoys inspecting troops has been warned against since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was on his way out of the pass to inspect Ningyuan when he heard the news and immediately memorialized: "Eunuch inspection of troops has been a warning sign since antiquity.

sentences.zh: 帝溫旨報之。

translations.literal: The emperor replied with a gentle edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied with a reassuring edict.

sentences.zh: 使者至，具杯茗而已。

translations.literal: When the envoys arrived, he provided only cups of tea.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoys arrived, he offered them nothing but tea.

sentences.zh: 鳴泰之為巡撫也，承宗薦之。

translations.literal: When Mingtai became governor, Chengzong had recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong had recommended Mingtai when he became governor.

sentences.zh: 後知其無實，軍事多不與議。

translations.literal: Later, knowing he lacked substance, Chengzong often did not consult him on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later, finding him incompetent, Chengzong largely excluded him from military deliberations.

sentences.zh: 鳴泰怏怏求去，承宗亦引疾。

translations.literal: Mingtai resentfully asked to leave, and Chengzong also cited illness.
translations.idiomatic: Mingtai resentfully asked to resign, and Chengzong also cited illness.

sentences.zh: 言官共留承宗，詆鳴泰 ，巡關御史潘雲翼復論劾之。

translations.literal: Remonstrance officials together urged keeping Chengzong and denounced Mingtai; border-inspecting censor Pan Yunyi again memorialized to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance officials united to keep Chengzong and attack Mingtai; border-inspecting censor Pan Yunyi again impeached him.

sentences.zh: 帝乃罷鳴泰，而以張鳳翼代。

translations.literal: The emperor then dismissed Mingtai and replaced him with Zhang Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dismissed Mingtai and replaced him with Zhang Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 鳳翼怯，復主守關議。

translations.literal: Fengyi was timid and again advocated the policy of defending only the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyi was timid and again advocated holding only the pass.

sentences.zh: 承宗不悅，乃復出關巡視。

translations.literal: Chengzong was displeased and again went out of the pass to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Displeased, Chengzong went out of the pass again to inspect the frontier.

sentences.zh: 抵寧遠，集將吏議所守。

translations.literal: On reaching Ningyuan he gathered generals and officials to discuss what should be held.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Ningyuan he gathered the officers to decide what positions to hold.

sentences.zh: 眾多如鳳翼指，獨世龍請守中後所，而崇煥、善繼及副將茅元儀力請守寧遠，承宗然之，議乃定。

translations.literal: Most followed Fengyi's view; only Shilong asked to hold Zhonghousuo, while Chonghuan, Shanji, and vice commander Mao Yuanji strongly asked to hold Ningyuan; Chengzong agreed with them, and the discussion was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Most sided with Fengyi; only Shilong favored holding Zhonghousuo, while Chonghuan, Shanji, and vice commander Mao Yuanji strongly urged holding Ningyuan; Chengzong agreed with them, and the decision was made.

sentences.zh: 令大壽興工，崇煥、滿桂守之。

translations.literal: He ordered Dashou to undertake construction, and Chonghuan and Man Gui to defend it.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Dashou to build the fort, with Chonghuan and Man Gui to defend it.

sentences.zh: 先是，虎部竊出盜掠，率教捕斬四人。

translations.literal: Earlier the Tiger tribe had slipped out to plunder; Shuaijiao captured and beheaded four men.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Tiger tribe had slipped out to raid; Shuaijiao captured and executed four of them.

sentences.zh: 象乾欲斬率教謝虎部，承宗不可。

translations.literal: Xiangqian wished to execute Shuaijiao to appease the Tiger tribe; Chengzong would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian wanted to execute Shuaijiao to appease the Tiger tribe; Chengzong refused.

sentences.zh: 而承宗所遣王楹戍中右，護其兵出採木，為西部朗素所殺。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Wang Ying, whom Chengzong had sent to garrison Zhongyou, escorted his troops out to gather timber and was killed by the western tribesman Langsu.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Wang Ying, whom Chengzong had posted at Zhongyou, was escorting troops out to gather timber when he was killed by the western tribesman Langsu.

sentences.zh: 承宗怒，遣世龍剿之。

translations.literal: Chengzong was angry and sent Shilong to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Chengzong sent Shilong to punish them.

sentences.zh: 象乾恐壞撫局，令郎素縛逃人為殺楹者以獻，而增市賞千金。

translations.literal: Xiangqian feared ruining the pacification arrangement, had Langsu bind up fugitives as Ying's killers and present them, and increased market rewards by a thousand in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian, fearing the pacification policy would collapse, had Langsu hand over fugitives as Ying's killers and increased market rewards by a thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 承宗方疏爭，而象乾以憂去。

translations.literal: Chengzong was just then memorializing in protest when Xiangqian left office on grounds of distress.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was still memorializing in protest when Xiangqian resigned on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 承宗患主款者撓己權，言督師、總督可勿兼設，請罷己，不可，則弗推總督。

translations.literal: Chengzong worried that advocates of appeasement were undermining his authority; he said army supervisor and governor-general need not both be established, asked to be dismissed himself, and if that was not possible, then not to recommend a governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong worried that appeasement advocates were undermining his authority; he argued that army supervisor and governor-general need not both exist, asked to resign, and if refused, asked that no governor-general be appointed.

sentences.zh: 並請以遼撫移駐寧遠。

translations.literal: He also asked that the Liaodong governor be moved to station at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that the Liaodong governor be relocated to Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 帝命止總督推 ，而鳳翼謂置己死地也，因大恨。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that recommendation of a governor-general cease; Fengyi said this placed him in a death trap and therefore hated Chengzong deeply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that no governor-general be appointed; Fengyi felt this left him in an impossible position and came to hate Chengzong bitterly.

sentences.zh: 與其鄉人雲翼、有孚等力毀世龍，以撼承宗。

translations.literal: With his fellow townsman Yunyi, Youfu, and others he strove to destroy Shilong in order to shake Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: He joined with his fellow townsman Yunyi, Youfu, and others to attack Shilong relentlessly, hoping to undermine Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 無何，有孚為薊撫岳和聲所劾，益疑世龍與崇煥構陷，乃共為浮言，撓出關計。

translations.literal: Before long Youfu was impeached by Ji governor Yue Hesheng; he increasingly suspected Shilong and Chonghuan of framing him, and together they spread empty talk to obstruct plans to go outside the pass.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Youfu was impeached by Ji governor Yue Hesheng; he increasingly suspected Shilong and Chonghuan of framing him, and together they spread rumors to obstruct Chengzong's plans outside the pass.

sentences.zh: 給事中解學龍遂極論世龍罪。

translations.literal: Supervising secretary Xie Xuelong then exhaustively discussed Shilong's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Xie Xuelong then launched a full attack on Shilong's conduct.

sentences.zh: 承宗憤，抗疏陳守御策，言：「拒敵門庭之中，與拒諸門庭外，勢既辨。

translations.literal: Chengzong, indignant, submitted a defiant memorial setting forth defense strategy, saying: "Resisting the enemy within one's courtyard gate and resisting him outside the courtyard gate—the strategic situation is already distinct.
translations.idiomatic: Indignant, Chengzong submitted a forceful memorial on defense strategy, saying: "Resisting the enemy at your own doorstep and resisting him beyond it are already two entirely different strategic situations.

sentences.zh: 我促敵二百里外，敵促我二百里中，勢又辨。

translations.literal: We press the enemy two hundred li away, while the enemy presses us within two hundred li—the situation is again distinct.
translations.idiomatic: We press the enemy two hundred li away, while the enemy presses us within two hundred li—the difference is again clear.

sentences.zh: 蓋廣寧，我遠而敵近；

translations.literal: At Guangning we were far and the enemy near;
translations.idiomatic: At Guangning we were far from our base and the enemy was near;

sentences.zh: 寧遠，我近而敵遠。

translations.literal: at Ningyuan we are near and the enemy far.
translations.idiomatic: at Ningyuan we are near our base and the enemy is far.

sentences.zh: 我不進逼敵，敵將進而逼我。

translations.literal: If we do not press the enemy, the enemy will advance and press us.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not press the enemy, the enemy will advance and press us.

sentences.zh: 今日即不能恢遼左，而寧遠、覺華終不可棄。

translations.literal: Today, even if we cannot recover eastern Liaodong, Ningyuan and Juehua must in the end not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Even if we cannot recover eastern Liaodong today, Ningyuan and Juehua must never be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 請敕廷臣雜議主、客之兵可否久戍，本折之餉可否久輸，關外之土地人民可否捐棄，屯築戰守可否興舉，再察敵人情形果否坐待可以消滅。

translations.literal: I ask that Your Majesty order court ministers to discuss together whether host and guest armies can garrison long, whether capital grain payments can be supplied long, whether land and people outside the pass can be cast away, whether field colonies, fortifications, war, and defense can be undertaken, and again examine whether the enemy's situation truly allows us to sit and wait until they can be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: I ask Your Majesty to order the court to debate whether our troops and the enemy's can garrison long, whether capital grain payments can be sustained, whether territory and people beyond the pass can be abandoned, whether military colonies and fortifications can be built, and whether the enemy truly can be destroyed by waiting.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢為百年久計，只計及五年間究竟何如。

translations.literal: Your servant dares not make plans for a hundred years; he only calculates how things will turn out within five years.
translations.idiomatic: I dare not plan for a century—only ask what the outcome will be within five years.

sentences.zh: 倘臣言不當，立斥臣以定大計，無紆迴不決，使全軀保妻子之臣附合眾喙，以殺臣一身而誤天下也。」

translations.literal: If your servant's words are improper, immediately dismiss him to settle the great plan; do not waver in indecision and let officials who preserve their bodies and protect their wives echo the crowd, killing your servant alone while misleading the realm."
translations.idiomatic: If I am wrong, dismiss me at once and settle the grand strategy—do not waver and let officials who care only for their own safety echo the crowd, sacrificing me while misleading the empire."

sentences.zh: 復為世龍辯，而發有孚等交構狀。

translations.literal: He again defended Shilong and exposed how Youfu and others had plotted against him.
translations.idiomatic: He again defended Shilong and exposed the plotting of Youfu and his allies.

sentences.zh: 有孚者，故侍郎世德子也，為廣寧理餉同知。

translations.literal: Youfu was the son of former vice minister Shide and served as Guangning grain intendant sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Youfu was the son of former vice minister Shide and had served as Guangning grain intendant.

sentences.zh: 城陷逃歸，象乾題為廣寧道僉事，專撫插漢 ，乾沒多。

translations.literal: When the city fell he fled back; Xiangqian nominated him Guangning circuit commissioner, put in charge of pacifying the Chahar, and embezzled heavily.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he fled; Xiangqian appointed him Guangning circuit commissioner in charge of pacifying the Chahar, and he embezzled heavily.

sentences.zh: 至是以承宗言被斥。

translations.literal: At this point, on Chengzong's word, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was now dismissed on Chengzong's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 鳳翼亦以憂歸，喻安性代。

translations.literal: Fengyi also returned on grounds of distress, and Yu Anxing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyi also resigned on grounds of illness, and Yu Anxing replaced him.

sentences.zh: 而廷臣言總督不可裁，命吳用先督薊、遼，代象乾。

translations.literal: But court ministers said the governor-general post could not be abolished; Wu Yongxian was ordered to supervise Ji and Liaodong, replacing Xiangqian.
translations.idiomatic: But the court insisted the governor-general post could not be abolished; Wu Yongxian was appointed to supervise Ji and Liaodong, replacing Xiangqian.

sentences.zh: 承宗惡本兵越彥多中制，稱疾求罷，舉彥自代以困之，廷議不可而止。

translations.literal: Chengzong disliked Minister of War Yue Yan's frequent central interference, cited illness to ask to resign, and recommended Yan to replace himself in order to embarrass him; court discussion found this unacceptable and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong disliked Minister of War Yue Yan's frequent interference from the capital, cited illness to resign, and recommended Yan to replace himself to embarrass him; the court rejected this and the matter ended.

sentences.zh: 時寧遠城工竣，關外守具畢備。

translations.literal: At that time the Ningyuan fort works were completed and defenses outside the pass were fully prepared.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Ningyuan fort was finished and frontier defenses outside the pass were fully in place.

sentences.zh: 承宗圖大舉，奏言：「前哨已置連山大凌河，速畀臣餉二十四萬，則功可立奏。」

translations.literal: Chengzong planned a major campaign and memorialized: "The forward post has already been set at Lianshan on the Greater Ling River; quickly grant your servant two hundred forty thousand in rations and merit can be reported at once."
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong planned a major offensive and memorialized: "Forward posts are already established at Lianshan on the Greater Ling River; grant me two hundred forty thousand taels in rations at once and success can be reported immediately."

sentences.zh: 帝命所司給之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to provide it.

sentences.zh: 兵、工二部相與謀曰：「餉足 ，渠即妄為，不如許而不與，文移往復稽緩之。」

translations.literal: The Ministries of War and Works plotted together, saying: "Once rations are sufficient he will act recklessly; better to promise but not deliver and delay him with back-and-forth documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministries of War and Works plotted together: "Once he has the funds he will act recklessly; better to promise but not deliver and delay him with paperwork.

sentences.zh: 承宗再疏促，具以情告。

translations.literal: Chengzong memorialized again to urge them and fully reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong memorialized again to press for payment and reported the full situation.

sentences.zh: 帝為飭諸曹，而師竟不果出。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked the offices for this, but in the end the army did not march out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked the ministries, but in the end the army never marched.

sentences.zh: 初，方震孺、游士任、李達、明時舉之譴，承宗實劾之，後皆為求宥。

translations.literal: Earlier Fang Zhenru, You Shiren, Li Da, and Ming Shiju had been punished; Chengzong had in fact impeached them, but later sought pardon for all of them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chengzong had impeached Fang Zhenru, You Shiren, Li Da, and Ming Shiju when they were punished, but later sought pardons for all of them.

sentences.zh: 復稱楊鎬、熊廷弼、王化貞之勞，請免死遣戍 ，朝端嘩然。

translations.literal: He again praised the services of Yang Hao, Xiong Tingbi, and Wang Huazhen and asked that they be spared death and sent to garrison duty; the court was in an uproar.
translations.idiomatic: He also praised the services of Yang Hao, Xiong Tingbi, and Wang Huazhen and asked that they be spared execution and sent to frontier garrison duty; the court was in an uproar.

sentences.zh: 給事中顧其仁、許譽卿，御史袁化中交章論駁，帝皆置弗省。

translations.literal: Supervising secretaries Gu Qiren and Xu Yuqing and censor Yuan Huazhong submitted successive memorials to refute this; the emperor set them all aside unread.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries Gu Qiren and Xu Yuqing and censor Yuan Huazhong submitted successive refutations; the emperor ignored them all.

sentences.zh: 會承宗敘五防效勞諸臣，且引疾乞罷，乃遣中官劉應坤等齎帑金十萬犒將士，而賜承宗坐蟒、膝襴，佐以金幣。

translations.literal: Just then Chengzong reported the merits of officials who had served in the five defenses and also cited illness to ask to resign; the emperor sent eunuch Liu Yingkun and others bearing one hundred thousand in treasury gold to reward officers and soldiers, and bestowed on Chengzong seated-python robes and knee-guards, supplemented with gold and coins.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Chengzong reported the merits of officials who had served on the five defense lines and cited illness to resign; the emperor sent eunuch Liu Yingkun and others with one hundred thousand taels to reward the troops, and gave Chengzong python robes and gold as consolation.

sentences.zh: 當是時，忠賢益盜柄。

translations.literal: At that time Zhongxian increasingly usurped power.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zhongxian was increasingly usurping power.

sentences.zh: 以承宗功高，欲親附之，令應坤等申意。

translations.literal: Because Chengzong's merit was high, he wished to draw him close and had Yingkun and others convey his intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Because Chengzong's achievements were great, he wished to win him over and had Yingkun convey his intentions.

sentences.zh: 承宗不與交一言，忠賢由是大憾。

translations.literal: Chengzong did not exchange a single word with him; Zhongxian therefore resented him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong would not exchange a word with him; Zhongxian therefore came to hate him deeply.

sentences.zh: 會忠賢逐楊漣、趙南星、高攀龍等 ，承宗方西巡薊、昌。

translations.literal: Just then Zhongxian drove out Yang Lian, Zhao Nanxing, Gao Panlong, and others; Chengzong was then on a western inspection tour of Ji and Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Zhongxian drove out Yang Lian, Zhao Nanxing, Gao Panlong, and others; Chengzong was on an inspection tour of Ji and Changping.

sentences.zh: 念抗疏帝未必親覽，往在講筵，每奏對輒有入，乃請以賀聖壽入朝面奏機宜，欲因是論其罪。

translations.literal: Reflecting that defiant memorials might not necessarily be read by the emperor personally, whereas in the lecture hall every memorial response had once gained access, he asked to enter court to congratulate the emperor's birthday and report strategy in person, intending thereby to discuss Zhongxian's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing that defiant memorials might never reach the emperor's eyes, whereas in the lecture hall his words had always been heard, he asked to enter court for the emperor's birthday and report strategy in person, intending to denounce Zhongxian's crimes.

sentences.zh: 魏廣微聞之，奔告忠賢：「承宗擁兵數萬將清君側，兵部侍郎李邦華為內主，公立齏粉矣！」

translations.literal: Wei Guangwei heard of it and ran to tell Zhongxian: "Chengzong holds tens of thousands of troops and is about to purge the emperor's side; Vice Minister of War Li Banghua is the inside patron—you, sir, will be reduced to powder at once!
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangwei heard of it and ran to tell Zhongxian: "Chengzong is marching on the capital with tens of thousands of troops to purge the court; Vice Minister Li Banghua is his inside patron—you will be destroyed!

sentences.zh: 忠賢悸甚，繞御床哭。

translations.literal: Zhongxian was greatly terrified and circled the imperial bed weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxian was terrified and circled the imperial bed weeping.

sentences.zh: 帝亦為心動，令內閣擬旨。

translations.literal: The emperor was also moved in heart and ordered the Grand Secretariat to draft an edict.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was also alarmed and ordered the Grand Secretariat to draft an edict.

sentences.zh: 次輔顧秉謙奮筆曰：「無旨離信地，非祖宗法，違者不宥。」

translations.literal: Second Grand Secretary Gu Bingqian wrote vigorously: "Leaving one's entrusted post without edict is not ancestral law; violators shall not be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Second Grand Secretary Gu Bingqian wrote swiftly: "Leaving one's post without imperial authorization violates ancestral law; violators shall not be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 夜啟禁門召兵部尚書入，令三道飛騎止之。

translations.literal: At night the forbidden gate was opened to summon the Minister of War in and order swift riders on three routes to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: That night the forbidden gate was opened to summon the minister of war and dispatch swift riders on three routes to stop Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 又矯旨諭九門守閹，承宗若至齊化門，反接以入。

translations.literal: They also forged an edict instructing the eunuch gatekeepers of the nine gates that if Chengzong reached Qihua Gate he was to be bound and brought in.
translations.idiomatic: They also forged an edict instructing the gatekeepers that if Chengzong reached Qihua Gate he was to be arrested and brought in.

sentences.zh: 承宗抵通州，聞命而返。

translations.literal: Chengzong reached Tongzhou, heard the order, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong reached Tongzhou, heard the order, and turned back.

sentences.zh: 忠賢遣人偵之，一襆被置輿中，後車鹿善繼而已，意少解。

translations.literal: Zhongxian sent men to spy on him; there was only one bundle of bedding placed in the carriage, with Lu Shanji alone in the rear cart, and his mind eased somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxian sent spies; Chengzong had only a bundle of bedding in his carriage and Lu Shanji alone following behind, and Zhongxian's suspicions eased somewhat.

sentences.zh: 而其黨李蕃、崔呈秀、徐大化連疏詆之，至比之王敦、李懷光。

translations.literal: Yet his partisans Li Fan, Cui Chengxiu, and Xu Dahua submitted successive memorials to slander him, even comparing him to Wang Dun and Li Huai'guang.
translations.idiomatic: But his partisans Li Fan, Cui Chengxiu, and Xu Dahua submitted successive attacks, even comparing him to Wang Dun and Li Huai'guang.

sentences.zh: 承宗乃杜門求罷。

translations.literal: Chengzong then shut his doors and asked to resign.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong then shut his doors and asked to resign.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，給事中郭興治請令廷臣議去留，論冒餉者復踵至，遂下廷臣雜議。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year supervising secretary Guo Xingzhi asked that court ministers discuss retention or dismissal; memorials on false ration claims again arrived in succession, and debate among ministers was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year supervising secretary Guo Xingzhi asked the court to debate whether Chengzong should stay or go; memorials on padded rations poured in again, and the court was ordered to debate.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書崔景榮持之，乃下詔勉留 ，而以簡將、汰兵、清餉三事責承宗。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Cui Jingrong upheld him; an edict was then issued urging him to remain, while charging Chengzong with three tasks: streamlining generals, eliminating troops, and clearing rations.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Cui Jingrong supported him; an edict urged him to stay while charging him with streamlining generals, cutting troops, and clearing padded rations.

sentences.zh: 奏報，承宗方遣諸將分戍錦州、大小凌河、松、杏、右屯諸要害，拓地復二百里，罷大將世欽、世祿，副將李秉誠、孫諫，汰軍萬七千余人，省度支六十八萬。

translations.literal: In his report Chengzong had just sent generals to garrison separately the strategic points of Jinzhou, the Greater and Lesser Ling Rivers, Song, Xing, and Youyun; recovered two hundred li of territory; dismissed great generals Shiqin and Shilu and vice generals Li Bingcheng and Sun Jian; eliminated more than seventeen thousand troops; and saved six hundred eighty thousand in revenue disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: In his report Chengzong had just posted generals at Jinzhou, the Greater and Lesser Ling Rivers, Song, Xing, and Youyun; recovered two hundred li of territory; dismissed generals Shiqin, Shilu, Li Bingcheng, and Sun Jian; cut more than seventeen thousand troops; and saved six hundred eighty thousand taels in expenditures.

sentences.zh: 而言官論世龍不已。

translations.literal: Yet remonstrance officials continued without end to discuss Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: But remonstrance officials continued to attack Shilong without cease.

sentences.zh: 至九月，遂有柳河之敗，死者四百余人，語詳《世龍傳》。

translations.literal: By the ninth month there was the defeat at Liuhe, with more than four hundred dead; details are given in the biography of Shilong.
translations.idiomatic: By the ninth month came the defeat at Liuhe, with more than four hundred dead; details are given in Shilong's biography.

sentences.zh: 於是臺省劾世龍並及承宗，章疏數十上。

translations.literal: Thereupon censorial and remonstrance offices impeached Shilong and implicated Chengzong as well; dozens of memorials were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Censors and remonstrance officials then impeached Shilong and implicated Chengzong as well; dozens of memorials poured in.

sentences.zh: 承宗求去益力，十月始得請。

translations.literal: Chengzong asked to leave with increasing force and only in the tenth month obtained permission.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong pressed ever harder to resign and only in the tenth month was his request granted.

sentences.zh: 先已屢加左柱國、少師、太子太師、中極殿大學士，遂加特進光祿大夫，廕子中書舍人，賜蟒服、銀幣，行人護歸。

translations.literal: He had already been repeatedly promoted to Left Pillar of State, Junior Mentor, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, and Grand Secretary of the Central Hall; he was then given the special advancement Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, his son ennobled as secretariat attendant, bestowed python robes and silver coins, and escorted home by imperial messengers.
translations.idiomatic: He had already been repeatedly promoted to Left Pillar of State, junior mentor, junior preceptor of the heir apparent, and grand secretary of the Central Hall; he was now given the special rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, his son ennobled as secretariat attendant, bestowed python robes and silver, and escorted home by imperial messengers.

sentences.zh: 而以兵部尚書高第代為經略。

translations.literal: Minister of War Gao Di was made commissioner in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Gao Di replaced him as frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 無何，安性亦罷，遂廢巡撫不設。

translations.literal: Before long Anxing was also dismissed, and the governorship was abolished and not re-established.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Anxing was also dismissed, and the governorship was abolished altogether.

sentences.zh: 初，第力扼承宗，請撤關外以守關內。

translations.literal: At first Di had strongly opposed Chengzong and asked to withdraw from outside the pass in order to defend inside the pass.
translations.idiomatic: At first Di had strongly opposed Chengzong and urged abandoning territory outside the pass to defend only within it.

sentences.zh: 承宗駁之，第深憾。

translations.literal: Chengzong refuted this; Di resented him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong refuted this; Di came to resent him deeply.

sentences.zh: 明年，寧遠被圍 ，乃疏言關門兵止存五萬，言者益以為承宗罪。

translations.literal: The next year, when Ningyuan was besieged, he memorialized that troops at the pass gate numbered only fifty thousand; critics increasingly blamed Chengzong.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when Ningyuan was besieged, he memorialized that only fifty thousand troops remained at the pass; critics increasingly blamed Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 承宗告戶部曰：「第初蒞關，嘗給十一萬七千人餉，今但給五萬人餉足矣。」

translations.literal: Chengzong told the Ministry of Revenue: "When Di first arrived at the pass he was once given rations for one hundred seventeen thousand men; now rations for only fifty thousand are enough.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong told the Ministry of Revenue: "When Di first arrived at the pass he was given rations for one hundred seventeen thousand men; now rations for fifty thousand are enough.

sentences.zh: 第果以妄言引罪。

translations.literal: Di indeed took blame on himself for false statements.
translations.idiomatic: Di indeed confessed to making false statements.

sentences.zh: 後忠賢遣其黨梁夢環巡關，欲傅致承宗罪，無所得而止。

translations.literal: Later Zhongxian sent his partisan Liang Menghuan to inspect the pass, wishing to fabricate charges against Chengzong; finding nothing, he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhongxian sent his follower Liang Menghuan to inspect the pass, hoping to fabricate charges against Chengzong; finding nothing, he gave up.

sentences.zh: 承宗在關四年，前後修復大城九、堡四十五，練兵十一萬，立車營十二、水營五、火營二、前鋒後勁營八，造甲胄、器械、弓矢、砲石、渠答、鹵楯之具合數百萬，拓地四百里，開屯五千頃，歲入十五萬。

translations.literal: Chengzong was at the pass four years; before and after he restored nine great cities and forty-five forts, drilled one hundred ten thousand troops, established twelve chariot camps, five water camps, two fire camps, and eight vanguard and reserve camps, and made armor, weapons, bows, arrows, cannon stones, caltrops, and salt shields totaling millions; he expanded territory four hundred li, opened five thousand qing of military colonies, and gained one hundred fifty thousand in annual revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During his four years at the pass Chengzong restored nine major cities and forty-five forts, drilled one hundred ten thousand troops, established twelve chariot camps, five water camps, two fire camps, and eight vanguard and reserve camps, and produced millions of items of armor, weapons, bows, arrows, cannon stones, caltrops, and shields; he expanded territory four hundred li, opened five thousand qing of military colonies, and brought in one hundred fifty thousand taels in annual revenue.

sentences.zh: 後敘寧遠功，廕子錦衣世千戶。

translations.literal: Later, when the merit of defending Ningyuan was reported, his son was ennobled as hereditary commander of the Brocade Guard at one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the defense of Ningyuan was rewarded, his son was ennobled as hereditary commander of the Brocade Guard at one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 庄烈帝即位，在晉入為兵部尚書，恨承宗不置，極論世龍及元儀熒惑樞輔壞關事，又嗾臺省交口詆承宗 ，以沮其出。

translations.literal: When the Zhuanglie Emperor ascended the throne, Zaijin entered office as Minister of War, bore resentment that Chengzong had not been appointed, exhaustively discussed how Shilong and Mao Yuanji had misled the chief minister and ruined border affairs, and also incited censorial and remonstrance offices to denounce Chengzong in concert in order to obstruct his coming out.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chongzhen Emperor ascended the throne, Zaijin became minister of war, resentful that Chengzong had not been appointed; he attacked Shilong and Mao Yuanji for misleading the chief minister and ruining frontier affairs, and incited censors and remonstrance officials to denounce Chengzong in concert to block his return.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，大清兵入大安口，取遵化，將薄都城，廷臣爭請召承宗。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year the Great Qing army entered Da'an Pass, took Zunhua, and was about to press on the capital; court ministers competed to ask that Chengzong be summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year the Qing army entered Da'an Pass, took Zunhua, and threatened the capital; court ministers competed to summon Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 詔以原官兼兵部尚書守通州，仍入朝陛見。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him, with his original rank and concurrently as Minister of War, to defend Tongzhou and still enter court for audience.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered, retaining his original rank and concurrently as minister of war, to defend Tongzhou and also appear at court.

sentences.zh: 承宗至，召對平臺。

translations.literal: When Chengzong arrived he was summoned to audience at the terrace.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong arrived he was summoned to audience at the terrace.

sentences.zh: 帝慰勞畢，問方略。

translations.literal: After the emperor had finished comforting and rewarding him, he asked about strategy.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor had finished comforting him, he asked about strategy.

sentences.zh: 承宗奏：「臣聞袁崇煥駐薊州，滿桂駐順義，侯世祿駐三河，此為得策。

translations.literal: Chengzong reported: "Your servant hears that Yuan Chonghuan is stationed at Jizhou, Man Gui at Shunyi, and Hou Shilu at Sanhe—this is the right strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong reported: "I hear that Yuan Chonghuan is at Jizhou, Man Gui at Shunyi, and Hou Shilu at Sanhe—that is the right disposition.

sentences.zh: 又聞尤世威回昌平，世祿駐通州，似未合宜。」

translations.literal: Your servant also hears that You Shiwei has returned to Changping and Shilu is stationed at Tongzhou—this seems not quite fitting."
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that You Shiwei has returned to Changping while Shilu is at Tongzhou—that seems less suitable."

sentences.zh: 帝問：「卿欲守三河，何意？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked: "You wish to hold Sanhe—what is your meaning?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked, "You want to hold Sanhe—what is your reasoning?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「守三河可以沮西奔，遏南下。」

translations.literal: He replied: "Holding Sanhe can obstruct a westward flight and check a southward advance."
translations.idiomatic: He answered, "Holding Sanhe can block a westward retreat and check a southward advance."

sentences.zh: 帝稱善，曰：「若何為朕保護京師？」

translations.literal: The emperor approved and said: "How will you protect the capital for Us?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and asked, "How will you protect the capital for me?"

sentences.zh: 承宗言：「當緩急之際，守陴人苦饑寒，非萬全策。

translations.literal: Chengzong said: "In moments of urgency, those defending the battlements suffer from hunger and cold—this is not a fully secure plan.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong said, "In a crisis, men on the battlements suffer hunger and cold—that is not a fully secure plan.

sentences.zh: 請整器械，厚犒勞，以固人心。」

translations.literal: Please put weapons in order and reward them generously to secure men's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Please put the weapons in order and reward the troops generously to steady their morale.

sentences.zh: 所條畫俱稱旨。

translations.literal: All his proposals pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: All his proposals pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿不須往通，其為朕總督京城內外守御事務，仍參帷幄。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "You need not go to Tongzhou; instead supervise for Us the defense affairs inside and outside the capital, and still take part in council.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You need not go to Tongzhou; instead supervise the defense of the capital inside and out, and remain in council.

sentences.zh: 趣首輔韓爌草敕下所司鑄關防。

translations.literal: He urged Chief Grand Secretary Han Kuang to draft an edict and order the offices to cast the pass seal.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Chief Grand Secretary Han Kuang to draft an edict and have the seal cast.

sentences.zh: 承宗出，漏下二十刻矣，即周閱都城，五鼓而畢，復出閱重城。

translations.literal: Chengzong left; it was already the twentieth watch of the night. He immediately made a full inspection of the capital city, finished at the fifth drum, and went out again to inspect the inner citadel.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong left court late at night, immediately made a full inspection of the capital, finished at the fifth watch, and went out again to inspect the inner citadel.

sentences.zh: 明日夜半，忽傳旨守通州。

translations.literal: At midnight the next day an edict suddenly arrived ordering him to defend Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the next day he was suddenly ordered to defend Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 時烽火遍近郊，承宗從二十七騎出東便門，道亡其三，疾馳抵通，門者幾不納。

translations.literal: Beacon fires then covered the near suburbs; Chengzong rode out the East Convenient Gate with twenty-seven horsemen, lost three on the road, galloped to Tongzhou, and the gatekeepers nearly refused him entry.
translations.idiomatic: Beacon fires blazed across the suburbs; Chengzong rode out the East Convenient Gate with twenty-seven horsemen, lost three on the way, galloped to Tongzhou, and the gatekeepers nearly refused him entry.

sentences.zh: 既入城，與保定巡撫解經傳、御史方大任、總兵楊國棟登陴固守。

translations.literal: Once inside the city he joined Baoding governor Xie Jingchuan, censor Fang Daren, and regional commander Yang Guodong on the battlements to defend firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Once inside he joined Baoding governor Xie Jingchuan, censor Fang Daren, and regional commander Yang Guodong on the walls to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 而大清兵已薄都城，乃急遣游擊尤岱以騎卒三千赴援。

translations.literal: The Great Qing army had already pressed on the capital; he urgently sent ranger You Dai with three thousand cavalry to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing army was already threatening the capital; he urgently sent ranger You Dai with three thousand cavalry to reinforce it.

sentences.zh: 旋遣副將劉國柱督軍二千與岱合，而發密雲兵三千營東直門，保定兵五千營廣寧門。

translations.literal: He then sent vice commander Liu Guozhu to supervise two thousand troops to join Dai, dispatched three thousand Miyun troops to camp at Dongzhimen, and five thousand Baoding troops to camp at Guangningmen.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent vice commander Liu Guozhu with two thousand men to join Dai, posted three thousand Miyun troops at Dongzhimen, and five thousand Baoding troops at Guangningmen.

sentences.zh: 以其間遣將復馬蘭、三屯二城。

translations.literal: In the meantime he sent generals to recover the two cities of Malan and Santun.
translations.idiomatic: In the meantime he sent generals to recover Malan and Santun.

sentences.zh: 至十二月四日，而有祖大壽之變。

translations.literal: By the fourth day of the twelfth month there occurred the upheaval of Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: By the fourth day of the twelfth month came the crisis of Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 大壽，遼東前鋒總兵官也，偕崇煥入衛。

translations.literal: Dashou was the Liaodong vanguard regional commander and had entered the capital guard together with Chonghuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou was the Liaodong vanguard commander and had entered the capital with Chonghuan.

sentences.zh: 見崇煥下吏，懼誅 ，遂與副將何可綱等率所部萬五千人東潰，遠近大震。

translations.literal: Seeing Chonghuan handed over to the law, he feared execution and therefore, with vice commander He Kegang and others, led his fifteen thousand troops in an eastward rout; near and far were greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Chonghuan arrested, he feared execution and with vice commander He Kegang led his fifteen thousand troops in an eastward rout, shocking the entire region.

sentences.zh: 承宗聞，急遣都司賈登科齎手書慰諭大壽，而令游擊石柱國馳撫諸軍。

translations.literal: When Chengzong heard, he urgently sent bureau director Jia Dengke bearing a personal letter to comfort and instruct Dashou, and ordered ranger Shi Zhuguo to gallop and pacify the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this Chengzong urgently sent bureau director Jia Dengke with a personal letter to reassure Dashou and ordered ranger Shi Zhuguo to ride out and calm the troops.

sentences.zh: 大壽見登科，言：「麾下卒赴援，連戰俱捷，冀得厚賞。

translations.literal: Dashou, on seeing Dengke, said: "The troops under my command went to reinforce, fought successive battles and all won, hoping for generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou told Dengke, "My men went to reinforce the capital, fought several battles and won each one, hoping for generous reward.

sentences.zh: 城上人群詈為賊，投石擊死數人。

translations.literal: On the walls the crowd cursed them as bandits and threw stones, killing several men.
translations.idiomatic: Men on the walls cursed them as traitors and threw stones, killing several.

sentences.zh: 所遣邏卒，指為間諜而殺之。

translations.literal: Patrol soldiers sent out were denounced as spies and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol soldiers we sent out were called spies and killed.

sentences.zh: 勞而見罪，是以奔還。

translations.literal: Having labored yet been punished, we therefore fled back.
translations.idiomatic: We fought hard yet were punished, and so we fled.

sentences.zh: 當出搗朵顏，然後束身歸命。」

translations.literal: We ought to strike out against the Tümed and then submit ourselves to judgment.
translations.idiomatic: We mean to raid the Tümed and then submit to judgment.

sentences.zh: 柱國追及諸軍，其將士持弓刀相向，皆垂涕，言：「督師既戮，又將以大砲擊斃我軍，故至此。」

translations.literal: Zhuguo overtook the troops; their officers and soldiers faced one another with bows and blades drawn, all in tears, saying: "The army supervisor has already been executed, and they are about to bombard and kill our army with great cannon—therefore we have come to this."
translations.idiomatic: Zhuguo overtook the troops; their officers and men faced one another with weapons drawn, all in tears, saying, "The army supervisor has been executed and they are about to bombard us with cannon—that is why we are here."

sentences.zh: 柱國復前追，大壽去已遠，乃返。

translations.literal: Zhuguo pressed on in pursuit again, but Dashou was already far away, and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuguo pressed on again, but Dashou was already far away, and he turned back.

sentences.zh: 承宗奏言：「大壽危疑已甚，又不肯受滿桂節制，因訛言激眾東奔，非部下盡欲叛也。

translations.literal: Chengzong memorialized: "Dashou is already deeply suspicious and fearful, and would not accept Man Gui's command; because of false rumors he incited the masses to flee east—not all his subordinates wish to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong memorialized: "Dashou is deeply suspicious and refused Man Gui's command; false rumors drove his men east—not all his troops wish to rebel.

sentences.zh: 當大開生路，曲收眾心。

translations.literal: One should open wide a path to life and win back the hearts of the masses with tact.
translations.idiomatic: We should open a way back for them and win back their hearts.

sentences.zh: 遼將多馬世龍舊部曲，臣謹用便宜，遣世龍馳諭，其將士必解甲歸，大壽不足慮也。」

translations.literal: Many Liaodong generals were old followers of Ma Shilong; your servant respectfully used expedient authority and sent Shilong to gallop and instruct them—their officers and soldiers will surely lay down arms and return; Dashou is not worth worrying over.
translations.idiomatic: Many Liaodong officers were Shilong's old followers; I have sent Shilong to reassure them—they will lay down arms and return, and Dashou need not be feared.

sentences.zh: 帝喜從之。
