translations.literal: The emperor gladly followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gladly agreed.

sentences.zh: 承宗密札諭大壽急上章自列，且立功贖督師罪，而己當代為剖白。

translations.literal: Chengzong sent a secret letter instructing Dashou to hurry and submit a memorial explaining himself, and also win merit to redeem the army supervisor's guilt, while he himself would speak on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong sent a secret letter urging Dashou to submit a memorial explaining himself, win merit to redeem Chonghuan, and promising to speak on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 大壽諾之，具列東奔之故，悉如將士言。

translations.literal: Dashou agreed and fully listed the reasons for the eastward flight, all matching what the officers and soldiers had said.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou agreed and listed the reasons for the flight, matching what his men had said.

sentences.zh: 帝優詔報之，命承宗移鎮關門。

translations.literal: The emperor replied with a gracious edict and ordered Chengzong to transfer his command to the pass gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied graciously and ordered Chengzong to take command at the pass.

sentences.zh: 諸將聞承宗、世龍至，多自拔來歸者。

translations.literal: When generals heard that Chengzong and Shilong had arrived, many came back of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: When the generals heard Chengzong and Shilong had arrived, many returned of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 大壽妻左氏亦以大義責其夫，大壽斂兵待命。

translations.literal: Dashou's wife, the Lady Zuo, also rebuked her husband on grounds of righteousness; Dashou gathered his troops and awaited orders.
translations.idiomatic: Dashou's wife Lady Zuo also rebuked him on grounds of loyalty; Dashou gathered his troops and awaited orders.

sentences.zh: 當潰兵出關，關城被劫掠，閉門罷市。

translations.literal: When the routed troops went out of the pass, the pass city was looted; gates were closed and markets shut.
translations.idiomatic: When the routed troops passed through, the pass city was looted, gates were closed, and markets shut down.

sentences.zh: 承宗至，人心始定。

translations.literal: When Chengzong arrived, people's hearts were finally settled.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong arrived, morale finally steadied.

sentences.zh: 關城故十六里，衛城止二里。

translations.literal: The pass city was originally sixteen li around; the guard city only two li.
translations.idiomatic: The pass city was originally sixteen li around; the inner guard city only two.

sentences.zh: 今敵在內 ，關城無可守，衛城連關，可步屟而上也。

translations.literal: Now with the enemy inside, the pass city could not be defended; the guard city connected with the pass city and one could walk up in slippers.
translations.idiomatic: Now with the enemy inside, the outer pass city could not be held; the inner guard city connected to it and could be climbed on foot.

sentences.zh: 乃別築牆，橫互於關城，穴之使砲可平出。

translations.literal: He therefore built a separate wall running across the pass city and bored holes so cannon could fire level outward.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore built a separate wall across the pass city with embrasures so cannon could fire level outward.

sentences.zh: 城中水不足，一晝夜穿鑿百井。

translations.literal: Water in the city was insufficient; in one day and night a hundred wells were dug.
translations.idiomatic: Water in the city was scarce; in one day and night a hundred wells were dug.

sentences.zh: 舊汰牙門將僑寓者千人，窮而思亂，皆廩之於官，使巡行街衢，守台護倉，均有所事。

translations.literal: A thousand former gate generals and sojourners who had been eliminated, poor and inclined to disorder, were all fed at government expense and made to patrol streets, guard platforms, and protect granaries, each with something to do.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand dismissed gate officers and displaced men, poor and restless, were all fed at government expense and assigned to patrol streets, guard platforms, and protect granaries.

sentences.zh: 內間不得發，外來者輒為邏騎所得，由是關門守完。

translations.literal: Internal agents could not act; outsiders coming in were promptly seized by patrol cavalry, and thus the pass gate defense was kept intact.
translations.idiomatic: Internal agents could not operate; outsiders were promptly seized by patrol cavalry, and the pass defenses held firm.

sentences.zh: 乃遣世龍督步騎兵萬五千入援，令游擊祖可法等率騎兵四營西戍撫寧。

translations.literal: He then sent Shilong to supervise fifteen thousand infantry and cavalry to reinforce the capital, and ordered ranger Zu Kefa and others to lead four cavalry camps to garrison Funing in the west.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Shilong with fifteen thousand infantry and cavalry to reinforce the capital and ordered ranger Zu Kefa and others with four cavalry camps to garrison Funing in the west.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，大壽入關謁承宗，親軍五百人甲而候於門。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year Dashou entered the pass to pay respects to Chengzong; five hundred personal guards in armor waited at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year Dashou entered the pass to see Chengzong; five hundred personal guards in armor waited at the gate.

sentences.zh: 承宗開誠與語，即日列其所統步騎三萬於教場，行誓師禮，群疑頓釋。

translations.literal: Chengzong spoke to him openly and sincerely; that same day he arrayed the thirty thousand infantry and cavalry under his command on the drill ground and performed the oath-taking ceremony; the crowd's suspicions were suddenly dispelled.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong spoke to him frankly; that same day he paraded his thirty thousand infantry and cavalry on the drill ground and held the oath-taking ceremony, and all suspicion vanished.

sentences.zh: 時我大清已拔遵化而守之。

translations.literal: At that time Our Great Qing had already taken Zunhua and was holding it.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Qing had taken Zunhua and were holding it.

sentences.zh: 是月四日拔永平。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of that month Yongping was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of that month Yongping fell.

sentences.zh: 八日拔遷安，遂下灤州。

translations.literal: On the eighth day Qian'an was taken, and then Luanzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day Qian'an fell, and then Luanzhou.

sentences.zh: 分兵攻撫寧，可法等堅守不下。

translations.literal: They divided troops to attack Funing; Kefa and others defended firmly and it did not fall.
translations.idiomatic: They sent detachments against Funing, but Kefa and others held firm and it did not fall.

sentences.zh: 大清兵遂向山海關，離三十里而營，副將官惟賢等力戰。

translations.literal: The Great Qing army then turned toward Shanhai Pass, encamped thirty li away, and vice commanders Guan Weixian and others fought strenuously.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing army then turned toward Shanhai Pass, encamped thirty li away, and vice commanders Guan Weixian and others fought hard.

sentences.zh: 乃還攻撫寧及昌黎 ，俱不下。

translations.literal: They then returned to attack Funing and Changli, but neither fell.
translations.idiomatic: They then returned to attack Funing and Changli, but neither fell.

sentences.zh: 當是時，京師道梗，承宗、大壽軍在東，世龍及四方援軍在西。

translations.literal: At that time the road to the capital was blocked; Chengzong's and Dashou's armies were in the east, while Shilong and relief armies from all directions were in the west.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the road to the capital was blocked; Chengzong and Dashou were in the east, while Shilong and relief armies from all directions were in the west.

sentences.zh: 承宗募死士沿海達京師，始知關城尚無恙。

translations.literal: Chengzong recruited dare-to-die men to reach the capital by sea and only then learned that the pass city was still unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong recruited dare-to-die men to reach the capital by sea and only then learned the pass city was still safe.

sentences.zh: 關西南三縣：曰撫寧、昌黎、樂亭，西北三城：曰石門、台頭、燕河。

translations.literal: Southwest of the pass were three counties: Funing, Changli, and Leting; northwest were three forts: Shimen, Taitou, and Yanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of the pass were three counties—Funing, Changli, and Leting; northwest were three forts—Shimen, Taitou, and Yanhe.

sentences.zh: 六城東護關門，西繞永平，皆近關要地。

translations.literal: The six cities guarded the pass gate to the east and curved around Yongping to the west—all strategic points near the pass.
translations.idiomatic: These six places guarded the pass to the east and curved around Yongping to the west—all key positions near the pass.

sentences.zh: 承宗飭諸城嚴守，而遣將戍開平，復建昌，聲援始接。

translations.literal: Chengzong ordered all the cities to defend strictly, sent generals to garrison Kaiping, recovered Jianchang, and supporting forces were finally linked.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong ordered all the cities to hold firm, sent generals to garrison Kaiping and recover Jianchang, and supporting forces were finally linked.

sentences.zh: 方京師戒嚴，天下勤王兵先後至者二十萬，皆壁於薊門及近畿，莫利先進。

translations.literal: Just as the capital was under martial law, relief armies from all under Heaven arriving in succession totaled two hundred thousand; all walled themselves in at the Ji gate and the near suburbs, none willing to advance first.
translations.idiomatic: While the capital was under martial law, two hundred thousand relief troops arrived from across the empire but all camped at the Ji gate and nearby suburbs, none willing to advance first.

sentences.zh: 詔旨屢督趣，諸將亦時戰攻 ，然莫能克復。

translations.literal: Edicts repeatedly urged them on; the generals also fought attacks from time to time, yet none could recover the cities.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts repeatedly urged them forward; the generals fought from time to time but could recover nothing.

sentences.zh: 世龍請先復遵化，承宗曰：「不然，遵在北，易取而難守，不如姑留之，以分其勢，而先圖灤。

translations.literal: Shilong asked to recover Zunhua first; Chengzong said: "Not so—Zunhua is to the north, easy to take but hard to hold; better to leave it for now to divide their strength and first target Luan.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong asked to retake Zunhua first; Chengzong said, "No—Zunhua is to the north, easy to take but hard to hold; better to leave it for now to divide their strength and target Luan first.

sentences.zh: 今當多為聲勢，示欲圖遵之狀以牽之。

translations.literal: Now we should make much clamor and show the appearance of intending to target Zunhua in order to tie them down.
translations.idiomatic: Now we should make a great show of intending to attack Zunhua to tie them down.

sentences.zh: 諸鎮赴豐潤、開平，聯關兵以圖灤。

translations.literal: The various garrisons should go to Fengrun and Kaiping and join pass troops to target Luan.
translations.idiomatic: The various garrisons should move to Fengrun and Kaiping and join pass troops to take Luan.

sentences.zh: 得灤則以開平兵守之，而騎兵決戰以圖永。

translations.literal: Once Luan is taken, use Kaiping troops to hold it, and let cavalry fight a decisive battle to target Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Once Luan is taken, garrison it with Kaiping troops and let cavalry fight a decisive battle for Yongping.

sentences.zh: 得灤、永則關、永合，而取遵易易矣。」

translations.literal: Once Luan and Yong are taken, pass and Yong will join, and taking Zun will be very easy."
translations.idiomatic: Once Luan and Yongping are taken, the pass and Yongping will be linked, and Zunhua will be easy to recover."

sentences.zh: 議既定，乃令東西諸營併進，親詣撫寧以督之。

translations.literal: Once the plan was settled, he ordered eastern and western camps to advance together and went in person to Funing to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Once the plan was settled, he ordered the eastern and western camps to advance together and went in person to Funing to supervise.

sentences.zh: 五月十日，大壽及張春、邱禾嘉諸軍先抵灤城下，世龍及尤世祿、吳自勉、楊麒、王承恩繼至，越二日克之，而副將王維城等亦入遷安。

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the fifth month Dashou and the armies of Zhang Chun, Qiu Hejia, and others first reached below Luan city; Shilong and You Shilu, Wu Zimian, Yang Qi, and Wang Chengen followed; after two days it was taken, and vice commander Wang Weicheng and others also entered Qian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day of the fifth month Dashou and the armies of Zhang Chun and Qiu Hejia reached Luan first; Shilong, You Shilu, Wu Zimian, Yang Qi, and Wang Chengen followed; two days later Luan fell, and vice commander Wang Weicheng entered Qian'an.

sentences.zh: 我大清兵守永平者，盡撤而北還，承宗遂入永平。

translations.literal: Our Great Qing troops holding Yongping all withdrew north; Chengzong then entered Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing troops holding Yongping all withdrew north; Chengzong then entered Yongping.

sentences.zh: 十六日，諸將謝尚政等亦入遵化。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day generals Xie Shangzheng and others also entered Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day generals Xie Shangzheng and others also entered Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 四城俱復。

translations.literal: All four cities were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: All four cities were recovered.

sentences.zh: 帝為告謝郊廟，大行賞賚，加承宗太傅，賜蟒服、白金，世襲錦衣衛指揮僉事。

translations.literal: The emperor reported thanks at the suburban altars, bestowed rewards on a grand scale, promoted Chengzong to Grand Preceptor, granted python robes and white silver, and ennobled him as hereditary assistant commander of the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported thanks at the suburban altars, rewarded him lavishly, promoted him to grand preceptor, granted python robes and silver, and ennobled him as hereditary assistant commander of the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 力辭太傅不受，而屢疏稱疾乞休，優詔不允。

translations.literal: He strenuously declined the Grand Preceptor title and did not accept it, yet repeatedly memorialized citing illness to ask to retire; gracious edicts did not grant this.
translations.idiomatic: He strenuously declined the grand preceptor title but repeatedly memorialized citing illness to retire; gracious edicts refused.

sentences.zh: 朵顏束不的反覆，承宗令大將王威擊敗之，復賚銀幣。

translations.literal: The Tümed chief Subu turned back and forth; Chengzong ordered great general Wang Wei to defeat him and again bestowed silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: The Tümed chief Subu wavered again; Chengzong ordered general Wang Wei to defeat him and again bestowed silver.

sentences.zh: 先以冊立東宮，加太保；

translations.literal: Earlier, on the investiture of the Eastern Palace heir, he was made Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the crown prince was invested, he was made grand guardian;

sentences.zh: 及《神宗實錄》成，加官亦如之。

translations.literal: when the Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong were completed, he was promoted in office likewise.
translations.idiomatic: and when the Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong were completed, he received a similar promotion.

sentences.zh: 並辭免 ，而乞休不已。

translations.literal: He declined both, yet asked to retire without cease.
translations.idiomatic: He declined both but continued to ask to retire.

sentences.zh: 帝命閣臣議去留，不能決。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered grand secretaries to discuss retention or dismissal, but they could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the grand secretaries to debate whether he should stay or go, but they could not decide.

sentences.zh: 特遣中書齎手詔慰問，乃起視事。

translations.literal: He specially sent a secretariat attendant bearing a handwritten edict to comfort him, and Chengzong then rose to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He specially sent a secretariat attendant with a handwritten edict of comfort, and Chengzong then resumed duty.

sentences.zh: 四年正月出關東巡，抵松山、錦州，還入關，復西巡，遍閱三協十二路而返。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year he went out of the pass on an eastern inspection tour, reached Songshan and Jinzhou, returned inside the pass, then made a western tour, thoroughly inspecting the three commands and twelve routes before returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year he toured east beyond the pass to Songshan and Jinzhou, returned, then toured west, inspecting all three commands and twelve routes before returning.

sentences.zh: 條上東西邊政八事，帝咸採納。

translations.literal: He listed eight items on eastern and western border administration; the emperor adopted them all.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted eight proposals on eastern and western frontier administration; the emperor adopted them all.

sentences.zh: 五月以考滿，詔加太傅兼食尚書俸，廕尚寶司丞，賚蟒服、銀幣、羊酒，復辭太傅不受。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on completion of his performance review, an edict added Grand Preceptor with ministerial salary, ennobled his son as vice director of the Imperial Treasures Office, and bestowed python robes, silver, coins, sheep, and wine; he again declined the Grand Preceptor title and did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on completion of his performance review, he was promoted to grand preceptor with ministerial salary, his son ennobled as vice director of the Imperial Treasures Office, and given python robes, silver, sheep, and wine; he again declined the grand preceptor title.

sentences.zh: 初，右屯、大凌河二城，承宗已設兵戍守。

translations.literal: At first Chengzong had already stationed troops to garrison the two cities of Youyun and the Greater Ling River.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chengzong had garrisoned the two cities of Youyun and Dalinghe.

sentences.zh: 後高第來代，盡撤之，二城遂被毀。

translations.literal: Later, when Gao Di came to replace him, he withdrew them all, and the two cities were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Gao Di replaced him, he withdrew all the garrisons and both cities were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 至是 ，禾嘉巡撫遼東，議復取廣寧、義州、右屯三城。

translations.literal: At this point Hejia was governor of Liaodong and discussed recovering the three cities of Guangning, Yizhou, and Youyun.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Hejia was Liaodong governor and proposed recovering Guangning, Yizhou, and Youyun.

sentences.zh: 承宗言廣寧道遠，當先據右屯，築城大凌河，以漸而進。

translations.literal: Chengzong said Guangning was far and one should first hold Youyun, build a city on the Greater Ling River, and advance gradually.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong said Guangning was too far and one should first hold Youyun, build a fort on the Greater Ling River, and advance step by step.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書梁廷棟主之，遂以七月興工，工甫竣，我大清兵大至，圍數周。

translations.literal: Minister of War Liang Tingdong supported this; work began in the seventh month, and just as it was completed Our Great Qing army arrived in force and besieged it for several rounds.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Liang Tingdong supported this; work began in the seventh month, and just as it was finished the Qing army arrived in force and besieged it repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 承宗聞，馳赴錦州，遣吳襄、宋偉往救。

translations.literal: On hearing this Chengzong galloped to Jinzhou and sent Wu Xiang and Song Wei to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing this Chengzong galloped to Jinzhou and sent Wu Xiang and Song Wei to relieve the siege.

sentences.zh: 禾嘉屢易師期，偉與襄又不相能，遂大敗於長山。

translations.literal: Hejia repeatedly changed the date for mobilization; Wei and Xiang also could not cooperate, and they suffered a great defeat at Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: Hejia repeatedly changed the mobilization date; Wei and Xiang could not cooperate, and they suffered a crushing defeat at Changshan.

sentences.zh: 至十月，城中糧盡援絕，守將祖大壽力屈出降，城復被毀。

translations.literal: By the tenth month grain in the city was exhausted and relief cut off; defending general Zu Dashou, his strength spent, surrendered, and the city was destroyed again.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month the city had run out of food and relief; defending general Zu Dashou surrendered, and the city was destroyed again.

sentences.zh: 廷臣追咎築城非策也，交章論禾嘉及承宗，承宗復連疏引疾。

translations.literal: Court ministers traced blame to the fort-building as a mistaken policy and submitted successive memorials discussing Hejia and Chengzong; Chengzong again submitted successive memorials citing illness.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers blamed the fort-building as a mistaken policy and attacked Hejia and Chengzong; Chengzong again cited illness in successive memorials.

sentences.zh: 十一月得請，賜銀幣乘傳歸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month his request was granted; he was given silver and coins and returned by relay post.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month his request was granted; he was given silver and escorted home by relay post.

sentences.zh: 言者追論其喪師辱國，奪官閒住，並奪寧遠世廕。

translations.literal: Critics pursued discussion of his loss of troops and disgrace to the state; his office was stripped and he was made to live in retirement, and the hereditary ennoblement from Ningyuan was also taken away.
translations.idiomatic: Critics pursued charges of losing troops and disgracing the state; his office was stripped, he was placed in retirement, and the hereditary ennoblement from Ningyuan was revoked.

sentences.zh: 承宗復列上邊計十六事，而極言禾嘉軍謀牴牾之失，帝報聞而已。

translations.literal: Chengzong again listed sixteen border plans and spoke exhaustively of Hejia's failures in military planning and mutual obstruction; the emperor merely acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong again submitted sixteen frontier proposals and spoke at length of Hejia's failures in military planning; the emperor merely acknowledged receipt.

sentences.zh: 家居七年，中外屢請召用，不報。

translations.literal: He lived at home seven years; inside and outside the court repeatedly asked that he be summoned to service, but no reply came.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for seven years; court and country repeatedly asked that he be recalled, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 十一年，我大清兵深入內地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Our Great Qing army penetrated deep into the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Qing army penetrated deep into the interior.

sentences.zh: 以十一月九日攻高陽，承宗率家人拒守。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the eleventh month they attacked Gaoyang; Chengzong led his household in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the eleventh month they attacked Gaoyang; Chengzong led his household in defense.

sentences.zh: 大兵將引去，繞城納喊者三，守者亦應之三，曰：「此城笑也，於法當破」，圍復合。

translations.literal: The great army was about to withdraw; they circled the city shouting three times, and the defenders answered three times; they said: "This city laughs—by rule it should be broken," and the siege closed again.
translations.idiomatic: The army was about to withdraw; they circled the city shouting three times, and the defenders answered three times; they said, "This city mocks us—by their law it must be taken," and the siege closed again.

sentences.zh: 明日城陷，被執。

translations.literal: The next day the city fell and he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the city fell and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 望闕叩頭，投繯而死，年七十有六。

translations.literal: He looked toward the palace, kowtowed, and hanged himself; he was seventy-six years old.
translations.idiomatic: He faced the capital, kowtowed, and hanged himself; he was seventy-six years old.

sentences.zh: 子 鉁 等

translations.literal: Sons: Qin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: His sons: Qin, et al.

sentences.zh: 子舉人鉁，尚寶丞鑰，官生鈰，生員鋡、鎬，從子煉 ，及孫之沆、之滂、之澋、之潔、之瀗，從孫之澈、之渼、之泳、之澤、之渙、之瀚，皆戰死。

translations.literal: His son the juren Qin, Imperial Treasures vice director Yao, official student Shi, students Qian and Hao, nephew Lian, and grandsons Zhihao, Zhipang, Zhihuan, Zhijie, and Zhixian, and grandnephews Zhiche, Zhimei, Zhiyong, Zhize, Zhihuan, and Zhihan—all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: His son the juren Qin, Imperial Treasures vice director Yao, official student Shi, students Qian and Hao, nephew Lian, grandsons Zhihao, Zhipang, Zhihuan, Zhijie, and Zhixian, and grandnephews Zhiche, Zhimei, Zhiyong, Zhize, Zhihuan, and Zhihan—all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 督師中官高起潛以聞。

translations.literal: Army-supervising eunuch Gao Qiqian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Army-supervising eunuch Gao Qiqian reported the news.

sentences.zh: 帝嗟悼，命所司優恤。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed in grief and ordered the offices to grant generous relief.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned and ordered generous relief for the family.

sentences.zh: 當國者楊嗣昌、薛國觀輩陰扼之，但復故官，予祭葬而已。

translations.literal: Those holding power, such as Yang Sichang and Xue Guoguan, secretly obstructed him; he was only restored to his former office and granted sacrificial rites and burial—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: Men in power such as Yang Sichang and Xue Guoguan secretly blocked further honors; he was only restored to his former rank and granted funeral rites—that was all.

sentences.zh: 福王時，始贈太師，諡文忠。

translations.literal: Only in the time of the Prince of Fu was he posthumously made Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Wenzong (Loyal in Culture).
translations.idiomatic: Only under the Prince of Fu was he posthumously made grand preceptor and given the posthumous title Wenzong, Loyal in Culture.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：承宗以宰相再視師，皆粗有成效矣，奄豎斗筲，後先齮扼，卒屏諸田野 ，至闔門膏斧釒質，而恤典不加。

translations.literal: The appraiser says: Chengzong, as chief minister, twice took command in the field and in each case achieved rough results; eunuchs of petty measure, one after another, gnawed and obstructed him, until at last he was driven to the countryside, and when his whole household met the axe, no generous posthumous rites were added.
translations.idiomatic: The appraiser says: As chief minister Chengzong twice took field command and each time achieved real results; petty eunuchs gnawed at him one after another until he was driven into retirement, and when his whole household perished by the sword, no fitting posthumous honors were granted.

sentences.zh: 國是如此，求無危，安可得也。

translations.literal: When the state is like this, to seek no peril—how can it be obtained?
translations.idiomatic: When the state is like this, how can it hope to escape peril?

sentences.zh: 夫攻不足者守有余，度彼之才，恢復固未易言，令專任之，猶足以慎固封守；

translations.literal: One who lacks strength for attack may still have surplus for defense; gauging his talent, recovery was indeed not easy to speak of, yet if entrusted solely to him, he was still sufficient to guard and secure the frontier carefully;
translations.idiomatic: A man weak in attack may still be strong in defense; judging his talent, recovery was never easy to promise, yet if given full authority he was still enough to hold the frontier firm;

sentences.zh: 而廷論紛呶，亟行翦除。

translations.literal: yet court debate was clamorous and he was swiftly cut down.
translations.idiomatic: yet the court clamored and he was swiftly removed.

sentences.zh: 蓋天眷有德，氣運將更，有莫之為而為者夫。

translations.literal: Surely Heaven favors the virtuous and the tide of fortune is about to turn—there are things done with no one doing them.
translations.idiomatic: Surely Heaven favors the virtuous and the age is turning—there are forces at work beyond any man's doing.
